name: get_date_time
description: Return the current date and time, optionally in a specific timezone or format.

format.description: Python strftime format string (e.g. "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"). Defaults to ISO 8601.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. "Europe/Paris", "UTC"). Defaults to the system local timezone.

datetime.description: Formatted datetime using the requested format.

timezone.description: The timezone used (IANA name or offset).

day_of_week.description: Day of the week name, e.g. "Monday".
